"""Straightforward reference implementation of TRACE.md replay semantics."""
import sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import para, topo


def ref_replay(prof, fabric, guard_ns, trace):
    cal = para.Calibration(prof)
    if not cal.feasible:
        return {"status": "inconsistent", "cycle": cal.cycle}
    F = topo.Fabric(fabric, cal)
    N, T, S, O, P, Q = F.N, F.T, F.S, F.O, F.P, F.Q
    R = trace['rounds']
    rates = trace['rates_ppb']
    bias = trace['bias_ps']
    sends = trace['sends']
    lost = set(trace['lost'])
    reboots = trace['reboots']
    queries = trace['queries']
    g = guard_ns

    err = [None]*N; bnd = [None]*N; gen = [0]*N
    peak = 0; always_known = True
    send_status = [None]*len(sends)
    delivered = 0; adopted = 0; unknown_c = 0; stale_c = 0; pending = 0
    states = {}
    inflight = []   # (app_boundary, id, src, dst, src_gen, dst_gen, err, bnd)

    for t in range(R+1):
        phase = t % P
        if t > 0:
            for i in range(N):
                if err[i] is not None:
                    err[i] += rates[t-1][i]*T
                    bnd[i] += F.rate[(t-1) % P][i]*T
                    if abs(err[i]) > peak: peak = abs(err[i])
        for (tick, node) in reboots:
            if tick == t:
                gen[node] += 1; err[node] = None; bnd[node] = None
        for i in F.anchor_nodes[phase]:
            err[i] = 0; bnd[i] = 0
        # applications
        due = [pk for pk in inflight if pk[0] == t]
        inflight = [pk for pk in inflight if pk[0] != t]
        delivered += len(due)
        cands = {}
        for pk in due:
            _, pid, src, dst, sgen, dgen, perr, pbnd = pk
            if sgen != gen[src] or dgen != gen[dst]:
                stale_c += 1; continue
            if perr is None:
                unknown_c += 1; continue
            cur = cands.get(dst)
            if cur is None or (pbnd, pid) < (cur[6], cur[1]):
                cands[dst] = pk
        ad = [None]*N
        for dst, pk in cands.items():
            if bnd[dst] is None or pk[6] < bnd[dst]:
                bnd[dst] = pk[6]; err[dst] = pk[5+1]; ad[dst] = pk[1]
                adopted += 1
                if abs(err[dst]) > peak: peak = abs(err[dst])
        if None in err: always_known = False
        if t in set(queries):
            states[t] = (list(bnd), list(err), list(ad), list(gen))
        # sends
        base = O + t*T
        rho = base % S
        slice_idx = (base//S) % Q
        allowed = F.slice_set[slice_idx]
        # priority: larger packet id first
        order = sorted(range(len(sends)), key=lambda k: -sends[k][0])
        used = set()
        for k in order:
            sid, tick, code, jit = sends[k]
            if tick != t: continue
            lid = code//2; dr = code%2
            if lid not in allowed:
                send_status[k] = 'not_in_slice'; continue
            link = F.links[lid]
            if dr == 0:
                src = link['ends'][0][0]; slot = link['ends'][0][1]; gs = link['ends'][0][2]
                dst = link['ends'][1][0]; gd = link['ends'][1][2]
                delay = link['delay_ns'][0]; defer = link['defer_rounds'][0]
            else:
                src = link['ends'][1][0]; slot = link['ends'][1][1]; gs = link['ends'][1][2]
                dst = link['ends'][0][0]; gd = link['ends'][0][2]
                delay = link['delay_ns'][1]; defer = link['defer_rounds'][1]
            if F.blocked(lid, phase, delay):
                send_status[k] = 'blackout'; continue
            if rho < g or rho + delay + g > S:
                send_status[k] = 'guard'; continue
            if (src, slot) in used:
                send_status[k] = 'port_busy'; continue
            used.add((src, slot))
            if sid in lost:
                send_status[k] = 'lost'; continue
            send_status[k] = 'sent'
            x1 = rho + delay
            delta = (x1 + T - 1)//T + defer
            app = t + delta
            if app > R:
                pending += 1; continue
            # ageing from reception to application
            age_err = 0; age_bnd = 0
            x = x1
            while x < delta*T:
                m = x//T
                nxt = min((m+1)*T, delta*T)
                age_err += rates[t+m][dst]*(nxt-x)
                age_bnd += F.rate[(t+m) % P][dst]*(nxt-x)
                x = nxt
            if err[src] is None:
                perr = None; pbnd = None
            else:
                perr = err[src] + (bias[gd]-bias[gs])*10**6 + jit - F.corr_by_code[code] + age_err
                pbnd = bnd[src] + F.allow_by_code[code] + age_bnd
            inflight.append((app, sid, src, dst, gen[src], gen[dst], perr, pbnd))
    out_states = []
    for q in queries:
        s = states[q]
        out_states.append({'bounds_as': s[0], 'errors_as': s[1], 'adopted': s[2], 'generations': s[3]})
    return {'status':'ok','states':out_states,'send_status':send_status,'delivered':delivered,
            'adopted':adopted,'unknown_payloads':unknown_c,'stale_payloads':stale_c,
            'pending':pending,'peak_known_abs_as':peak,'always_known':always_known}
PYEOF
